baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two dual conditionals join heart-inclination, mutual backing against him, and a counter-network of guardians and supporters.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inward tilt becomes a social alignment: the two may redirect together through repentance or reinforce one another against him, while the second half answers that backing with a wider coalition.

activation_trace.role: Heartward inclination supplies the directional bias that can become loyalty.
Turning something from one face to another makes the heart a reversible orientation rather than a fixed essence.
Strength gained through backing names both the possible pair-alliance and the answering support.
Loving protection gives the counter-network its relational center.
Removal of estrangement lets righteous support function as a reconciliatory alternative to faction.

changed_reading.before: A warning to two people followed by a list of allies.
changed_reading.after: A map of rival alignments in which inward tilt, paired backing, repentance, and counter-backing are causally connected.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from divine guardianship through named supporters to angels after that is explicitly ordered, and the support root recurs at both ends of the conflict.
baseline_models.mechanism: The support list is staged rather than flat: primary guardianship is followed by proximate agents, then an additional angelic reserve marked as subsequent and precautionary reinforcement.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the first governing layer of protection.
The explicit angel branch identifies the final supporting class literally.
Succession after what precedes it turns the final class into a later layer rather than another coordinate name.
Extra provision for precaution casts the final support as reserve capacity held beyond the named allies.

changed_reading.before: All named supporters form one undifferentiated roster.
changed_reading.after: The ayah escalates through an ordered protection architecture, ending with surplus or reserve backing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The heart-tilt can activate the inventory's listening branch as well as its loyalty branch, while repentance remains directly requested of the pair.
baseline_models.mechanism: The initial fault may be an attentional lean toward speech or influence that then becomes coordinated backing; this coexists with the stronger affective-allegiance reading.

activation_trace.role: Inclining the ear supplies an attentional route by which the hearts become biased.
The heart as understanding and inward apprehension locates that listening in judgment, not only emotion.
A summons to repentance makes the detected lean answerable and potentially reversible.

changed_reading.before: The hearts' inclination is only a settled emotional defection.
changed_reading.after: It may also be a listening or attention bias that becomes alliance, without excluding the loyalty reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding prohibition-permission problem is answered by a prescribed release of oaths and repeated divine guardianship. The focus conflict therefore sits inside a binding order that has an authorized way to loosen its knot and repair its boundary.

activation_trace.role: Prohibition supplies the boundary whose misapplication initiates the dispute.
Dissolution of a ban opposes the imposed restriction and opens a corrective route.
A bounded obligation makes the remedy formally delimited rather than improvised.
Release of an oath provides the concrete untying mechanism behind the correction.
The oath branch identifies the bond from which release is prescribed.
Guardianship repeated before the focus frames divine support as administration of the breached order.

structural_cues: The focus retains two conditional routes, repentance and continued backing, after 66:1-2 have already supplied both boundary and remedy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: prohibition, lawful release, oath, and guardianship precede the focus. Reader arrow: authorized untying makes repentance a bounded repair rather than capitulation in an open feud. Live alternative: these legal cues may only set the occasion and not define the support language.

changed_reading.before: The ayah announces a free-standing personal feud with opposing camps.
changed_reading.after: It intervenes in a correctable breach inside an existing moral and relational order whose knots can be lawfully loosened.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concealed utterance travels as reported news, becomes exposed, and is handled selectively. This gives the focus's heart-lean and paired backing an informational mechanism: attention to private speech becomes transmission, shared knowledge, and alliance.

activation_trace.role: Concealment in the interior supplies the starting state of the information channel.
Renewed speech as report gives the concealed matter transmissible form.
Repeated incoming and relayed news traces the movement of information among parties.
Emergence into visibility reverses the secret's hidden state and prefigures the focus's repeated support root.
Partition into portions explains selective disclosure and selective restraint.
Turning a side away supplies deliberate forbearance after partial exposure.

structural_cues: The repeated report verbs surround a sequence of concealment, transmission, exposure, partial identification, and partial turning-away immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: 66:3 supplies a full secret-to-report-to-exposure sequence. Reader arrow: that information flow enables the pair's mutual backing and activates the listening sense of heart-tilt. Live alternative: the pair's backing could be practical solidarity without an informational mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The two simply adopt a shared hostile posture.
changed_reading.after: Their alignment can be reconstructed as a disclosure network in which biased attention and transmitted private speech become coordinated backing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah combines release from marriage, substitution, pairing, comparative fitness, repentance, and obedience. The focus pair's solidarity is therefore not indispensable; relational positions can be reoccupied according to qualities rather than possession of a fixed status.

activation_trace.role: Release of the marriage bond makes replacement a materially live consequence.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the explicit role-substitution mechanism.
A counterpart joined to a counterpart identifies the relational position being reoccupied.
Excellence in fitness makes substitution evaluative rather than merely numerical.
Repentance reappears as a defining quality and links replacement directly back to the focus condition.
Submissive obedience contrasts the focus's possible counter-alliance with a role ordered by fidelity.

structural_cues: The long coordinated quality list in 66:5 turns persons into differentiated role-bearers; its branchless ث ي ب item is used only as part of that list structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: divorce, replacement, pairing, comparative goodness, and a quality list follow the warning. Reader arrow: replaceability explains why the focus's counter-support removes leverage from the pair's alliance. Live alternative: 66:5 may threaten succession without redefining support in 66:4.

changed_reading.before: The pair's alliance is dangerous because their relational positions are indispensable.
changed_reading.after: Their positions are contingent roles; repentance can restore fitness, while continued faction exposes their replaceability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Households must be actively guarded, and the angels are described as hard, strong, command-obeying executors; the later command to exert and be firm extends the same register. This sharpens the focus's final angelic reserve from emotional solidarity into an executable protection order.

activation_trace.role: Repelling harm by protection turns support into active household guarding.
A community of nearness and belonging fixes the immediate social perimeter being guarded.
The literal angel class identifies the same agents named as final support in the focus.
Harsh strength in treatment gives that support coercive execution capacity.
Concentrated force and solidity make the angelic layer dependable under resistance.
Binding command supplies the direction under which the agents act.
Effort under hardship extends support into sustained exertion rather than nominal affiliation.

structural_cues: The focus's after-that marker is followed in 66:6 by a direct description of angelic obedience and in 66:9 by a parallel imperative of firmness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: later verses supply guarding, angelic force, exact obedience, and strenuous firmness. Reader arrow: those properties fill in what the focus's reserve support can do. Live alternative: the angelic mention in 66:4 may remain purely honorific accompaniment.

changed_reading.before: The angels add prestige to a list of sympathizers.
changed_reading.after: They form a reserve execution layer within a command-governed architecture of protection and enforcement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated repentance is joined to purity and the sewing of a tear, protective covering, mobile light, connective space, supporting strength, and completion of a weave. Repentance in the focus can thus be active repair of a torn trust-network that restores coordinated movement.

activation_trace.role: The renewed summons to repentance directly reopens the focus's first conditional route.
Stitching a rupture supplies the material analogy for repairing breached trust.
Covering a fault while shielding its bearer gives repair a protective result rather than erasure alone.
Illumination supplies restored orientation after the heart's earlier tilt.
Purposeful movement makes restored orientation dynamically operative.
A connection standing between endpoints turns separation into a traversable relation.
The non-dominant mapped branch of supporting strength reinforces coordinated movement around the repentant group.
A piece that completes weaving extends the sewn-breach analogy toward restored wholeness.

structural_cues: Verse 66:8 repeats the repentance root twice, then places moving light before and beside the repentant speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: sincere repentance, sewing, covering, moving light, connection, support, and completion cluster in 66:8. Reader arrow: the textile and motion images model repair of the focus's broken alignment. Live alternative: the sequence may describe ethical purification and eschatological guidance without a relational repair metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Repentance is a verbal reversal that simply ends opposition.
changed_reading.after: Repentance is reparative work that closes a trust breach, recovers orientation, and makes coordinated movement possible again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first exemplum mirrors the focus's dual feminine grammar: two women are paired with two righteous servants, yet deficient fidelity defeats any benefit of household proximity. The focus's righteous believers and secure believers therefore name fidelity-bearing support, not inherited or marital access to protection.

activation_trace.role: Rendering an example visible signals that the following dual relation is meant to expose a mechanism.
An example as warning and sign licenses comparison with the focus's contested allegiance.
The two women provide the human pair whose dual action formally echoes the focus pair.
Integrity opposed to corruption links the righteous servants to the focus's righteous supporters.
Deficiency in fidelity and trust names the relation-breaking fault that proximity cannot cure.
Failed sufficiency demonstrates that another person's righteousness cannot substitute for one's own alignment.

structural_cues: The dual forms for the two women and their paired betrayal in 66:10 conspicuously echo the focus's two dual verbs and dual possessive hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a marked exemplum repeats dual women, righteous associates, breached fidelity, and failed benefit. Reader arrow: the formal mirror interprets the focus coalition through trust rather than mere kinship. Live alternative: the exemplum may address accountability generally without mirroring the two addressees specifically.

changed_reading.before: Standing near a righteous or powerful person may transfer protection, and support is mainly social proximity.
changed_reading.after: Protection does not transfer through household proximity; support in the focus is constituted by lived fidelity and trustworthy alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next exemplum places a requested house near God against an oppressive earthly household and asks for rescue by separation. This spatially activates divine guardianship in the focus as an alternative nearest relation that can relocate allegiance beyond the most immediate human power.

activation_trace.role: The second rendered example offers a contrasting allegiance mechanism rather than a repeated moral label.
The sign-bearing example invites the focus's guardianship relation to be tested against household power.
Building by joining parts gives the alternative home a constructed and durable form.
Near presence places desired proximity with God rather than with the earthly ruler.
Shelter and dwelling make divine nearness an alternative home, not only an abstract allegiance.
Deliverance by separation supplies the movement out of the oppressive nearest relation.
Withholding what is due identifies the surrounding order from which alternative guardianship rescues.

structural_cues: The locative request near God and the two rescue requests follow immediately after the exemplum in which husbands cannot save their wives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: 66:11 opposes a house near God to spouse, deed, and oppressive people, with rescue repeated. Reader arrow: this contrast spatializes the focus's divine guardianship as a nearer counter-household. Live alternative: the requested house may be solely eschatological reward, not a model of present allegiance.

changed_reading.before: God as guardian is an external champion added to his side.
changed_reading.after: Divine guardianship can become the nearest home-forming relation, overriding even spouse, household, and political enclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence distributes women across failed fidelity, resistance to an oppressive spouse, guarded receptivity, truth-confirmation, and obedience. That sequence resists treating the focus's feminine dual as a fixed moral category: it marks two present agents whose coalition and possible repentance remain contingent choices.

activation_trace.role: The paired women establish one possible configuration of female agency under intimate relation.
Failed fidelity marks that configuration as chosen relation-breaking conduct, not identity.
The singular woman supplies a contrasting agent within an adverse marriage.
Self-positioning toward rescue by separation shows allegiance diverging from spouse and people.
Preservation within a guarded boundary supplies a third mode of deliberate integrity.
Truth realized in commitment and action distinguishes fidelity from mere proximity.
Sustained obedient devotion closes the sequence with individually enacted alignment.

structural_cues: Two women acting in a dual in 66:10 are followed by two singular female exempla in 66:11-12, while the focus itself gives the two addressees both a joint offense and a joint route of repentance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the closing exempla vary female allegiance across dual and singular agents. Reader arrow: that variation prevents the focus dual from hardening into a category and preserves each addressee's agency. Live alternative: the exempla may contrast belief states without commenting on the rhetoric of the focus dual.

changed_reading.before: The two addressed women form one stable moral type or naturally unified bloc.
changed_reading.after: They are two contingent agents presently coordinating; the surrounding exempla keep coalition, rupture, resistance, and return as choices rather than category traits.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ت ب ب mapping and a vessel-like tilt as a cross-domain material analogy. It remains anchored in the packet's split mapping for the focus repentance root and the focus inclination verb. Downstream prose should call it a restabilization image, not a lexical replacement for repentance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly joins the mapped repentance form to an already tilted heart-state.

activation_trace.role: A matter becoming straight, prepared, and continuous supplies the unusual image of regained stability.
Physically tipping an object or head gives the diagnosed heart-state a material angle.
Turning from face to face supplies the corrective rotation by which a tipped system can be reset.

changed_reading.before: Repentance is only an inward moral reversal.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, repentance restabilizes a tilted relational system so it can run straight again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the live construction strongly supports mutual assistance, while the same inventory also preserves mutual back-turning. It remains anchored in the twice-used support root and the paired form. Downstream prose should retain it only as a shadow or fault-line within alliance, not as a grammatical disambiguation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same root spans the pair's possible action and the final answering supporter, making its divergent branch images internally consequential.

activation_trace.role: Partners turning their backs to one another supplies an inverse latent inside the overt backing relation.
Mutual strengthening through backing preserves the dominant alliance reading against which the inverse is measured.
Directional loyalty makes the alliance susceptible to reversal when its inward tilt changes.

changed_reading.before: The pair's united front is internally stable even if wrongly directed.
changed_reading.after: The support root carries a contained inverse: coordinated backing may conceal an alliance capable of becoming mutual back-turning.

strongest_changes: The focus became an information-mediated alliance after 66:3 supplied concealment, relay, exposure, and selective handling.
The legal boundary and oath-release sequence made repentance a bounded repair rather than capitulation in a free-standing feud.
Later angelic obedience turned the final supporter from honorific company into reserve execution capacity.
The paired counterexample made fidelity, not household proximity, the decisive condition of support.
The closing female exempla preserved individual agency and prevented the focus dual from becoming a fixed category.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated support root links the threatened alliance to its answer, while the dual morphology is mirrored and then broken apart by later exempla. Split-root and branch-distant images also preserved contained readings of mechanical restabilization and mutual back-turning.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the heart-tilt is primarily affective allegiance or attentional listening.
Whether after that marks strict sequence, rhetorical surplus, rank, or reserve capacity.
How tightly the later dual female exemplum is intended to mirror the two focus addressees.
Whether the sewing and weaving images in 66:8 should remain a local metaphor or materially revise the focus's repentance mechanism.
